title: Sr Analyst - Trade Finance
description:
**Company**
 Puma Energy is a leading global energy business which supplies, stores and distributes petroleum products in 47 countries across six continents. Founded in 1997, Puma Energy has its headquarters in Singapore and Geneva and employs over 8,000 people globally with regional hubs in South Africa, Puerto Rico and Estonia and have recently setup a Global Delivery Centre in Mumbai (India).
   

  

**Puma Processing Services LLP (PEPS) established in Year 2018, represents Puma Energy’s first captive offshoring unit and is based in Mumbai, India with over 200 employees.**
**Main Purpose:**
 To provide efficient finance operations and risk management for our international oil trading activities.
   

  

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**
* Issuance of L/C’s or Bank Guarantees for our purchases of Crude and Oil Products including negotiation with banks in order to place transactions under bilateral facilities.
* Review of contracts for all transactions in accordance with company policy and procedure
* To check and approve cargo loadings and discharges whilst ensuring contractual obligations are met without exposing the company to risk or loss.
* Risk covering sales where necessary with Banks and/or Insurance.
* Release and stock management, exposure monitoring and weekly m2m of any storage positions.
* Close co\-operation with our Deals Desk personnel to ensure any costs agreed by Trade Finance are allocated correctly to the separately maintained deal Profit and Loss accounts.
* Close co\-operation with our Oil Operations team to ensure that our physical logistical requirements are in alignment with financial and risk considerations
* Preparation and despatch of Invoices and Letters of Indemnity (or shipping documents) for payment under Documentary Letters of Credit received from our buyers.
* The reception / recording and distribution of shipping documents – including the allocation and despatch of such documents to our trading counter\-parts / financing banks enabling the prompt cancellation of outstanding LOI’s
* The regular chasing of any shipping documents not received in a timely manner from our trading counter\-parts / financing banks – thus ensuring that our credit facilities are used to an optimum level.
* Ensuring timely processing of Cargo payments together with managing cash positions with the Banks.
* Closely liaising with teams in Singapore/ Geneva/ Johannesburg and other onshore Puma locations


**Experience**
* 5\-8 years within a Trading Company / Financial institution having gained a basic understanding of the principals surrounding Trade Finance instruments and their pitfalls would be desirable
* Desirable knowledge on PEPS trading business, Finance, Inco Terms, Basics of LCs etc.
* Well\-organized and pro\-active, excellent communication skills, strong coordinating skills, able to demonstrate exceptional problem solving and the ability to think in a highly logical and critical fashion
* Highly diligent and sharp eye for attention to details
* Able to take initiative and not only work to, but also set their own quickly changing deadlines
* A team player, who is able to confidentially adapt their interpersonal approach as the situation demands, able to build strong relations both inter\-departmentally and with external stakeholders
* An individual who is not only comfortable but thrives in a high pressure environment
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Word and Excel
* Excellent spoken and written English


**Key Relationships**
* External – Banks, Insurance, Counterparties.
* Internal – Ops, Traders, Contracts, Treasury, Credit, Accounting \& Deals Desk

title: AVP/Business Head - Execution for Asset Reconstruction

description:
JOB DESCRIPTION
 



 AVP – ARC Business – Execution
 



**Department:** 
 ARC Business / Asset Resolution
 



**Reports To:** 
 Senior Management
 



**Location:** 
 Mumbai
 



**Experience Required:** 
 10–15 Years
 



**Educational Qualification:** 
 MBA in Finance / CA / CFA / CS / LLB or equivalent postgraduate qualification
 



 ABOUT THE ORGANISATION
 



 A leading
 **RBI\-registered Asset Reconstruction Company (ARC)** 
 engaged in the acquisition and resolution of stressed assets from banks and financial institutions.
 



 The organisation focuses on structured and efficient resolution strategies, including restructuring, enforcement and asset monetisation, with an emphasis on value maximisation and timely recovery.
 



 ROLE OVERVIEW
 



 The
 **AVP – ARC Business – Execution** 
 will be responsible for managing the
 **end\-to\-end execution of stressed\-asset transactions and resolution initiatives** 
 .
 



 The role will involve transaction evaluation, financial analysis, due diligence, structuring, bidding, documentation, transaction closure, asset onboarding and coordination with internal and external stakeholders.
 



 This is a
 **purely execution\-oriented role** 
 and does
 **not** 
 involve Business Development, Sales, Marketing, Origination or Asset Acquisition.
 



 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
 



**1\. Transaction Evaluation \& Execution** 



* Evaluate stressed\-asset opportunities referred for execution.
* Analyse borrower exposures, outstanding debt, security, recovery prospects and available information.
* Coordinate financial, legal, technical and commercial due diligence.
* Review valuations, cash flows, security cover and potential resolution scenarios.
* Prepare transaction evaluation notes and management presentations.



**2\. Deal Structuring \& Bidding** 



* Support structuring of stressed\-asset transactions within applicable regulatory and internal frameworks.
* Coordinate preparation and submission of bids under Swiss Challenge, bilateral and competitive processes.
* Review transaction structures, pricing assumptions and financial models.
* Coordinate with relevant stakeholders to ensure timely completion of bidding processes.



**3\. Transaction Closure \& Asset Onboarding** 



* Drive post\-bid execution and transaction closure activities.
* Coordinate documentation, conditions precedent and regulatory requirements.
* Work closely with Legal, Risk, Finance, Compliance and Resolution teams.
* Ensure smooth onboarding and transfer of assets following transaction closure.
* Track and resolve outstanding transaction\-related matters.



**4\. Resolution Execution Support** 



* Work closely with the Asset Resolution team in implementing approved resolution strategies.
* Support restructuring, enforcement, settlement and asset monetisation initiatives.
* Monitor resolution milestones, recovery actions and execution timelines.
* Provide periodic transaction and resolution updates to senior management.



**5\. Cross\-Functional Stakeholder Management** 



* Coordinate with internal teams and external legal, valuation, diligence and advisory professionals.
* Ensure timely exchange and validation of transaction information.
* Identify execution issues and coordinate their resolution.
* Escalate material transaction risks, delays and dependencies to senior management.



**6\. MIS, Governance \& Compliance** 



* Maintain transaction\-level MIS and execution trackers.
* Monitor transaction timelines, documentation and closure milestones.
* Ensure adherence to applicable RBI guidelines, regulatory requirements and internal policies.
* Maintain appropriate transaction documentation and records.
* Identify opportunities to improve transaction execution processes.



 KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS
 


* Timely execution and closure of transactions.
* Transaction evaluation quality and accuracy.
* Due diligence and documentation turnaround.
* Bidding\-process efficiency.
* Successful asset onboarding following transaction closure.
* Timely implementation of approved resolution strategies.
* Regulatory and process compliance.
* Effective cross\-functional stakeholder coordination.



 REQUIRED EXPERIENCE \& QUALIFICATIONS
 


* 10–15 years of relevant experience in
 **ARC, Banking, NBFC, Special Situations, Stressed Assets, Corporate Credit, Debt Resolution or Private Debt** 
 .
* Demonstrated experience in
 **transaction execution, stressed\-asset resolution or distressed\-debt processes** 
 .
* Experience in due diligence, transaction structuring, bidding, documentation and closure.
* MBA Finance / CA / CFA / CS / LLB or equivalent qualification preferred.



 REQUIRED SKILLS \& COMPETENCIES
 


* Strong understanding of
 **SARFAESI, IBC 2016, RBI regulations relating to transfer of loan exposures and debt restructuring mechanisms** 
 .
* Strong financial analysis and modelling skills.
* Experience in stressed\-asset transaction execution and resolution.
* Strong understanding of bidding and transaction\-closure processes.
* Excellent project and transaction management skills.
* Strong documentation and analytical capabilities.
* Ability to coordinate effectively with Legal, Risk, Finance, Compliance and Resolution teams.
* Strong communication and management\-presentation skills.



 ROLE EXCLUSIONS
 



 This position is
 **strictly execution\-focused** 
 and does
 **not** 
 carry responsibility for:
 


* Business Development / Sales
* Marketing / Brand Building
* Asset Origination
* Asset Sourcing / Acquisition
* Lead Generation
* Investor Acquisition
* Capital Raising
* Relationship\-led Business Generation



**Primary focus: Transaction Evaluation → Due Diligence → Structuring → Bidding → Closure → Asset Onboarding → Resolution Execution.**

title: Renewable Energy Coordinator
description:
****Title:****
 Renewable Energy Coordinator
   

  

****Business Unit:****
 Projects \& Engineering
   

  

**Job Grade**
 G11B / Senior Executive
   

  

**Location:**
 Mumbai
   

  

****Key Responsibilities****
 At Sun Pharma, we commit to helping you “
 **Create your own sunshine** 
 ”— by fostering an environment where you grow at every step, take charge of your journey and thrive in a supportive community.
   

  

**Are You Ready to Create Your Own Sunshine?**
 As you enter the Sun Pharma world, you’ll find yourself becoming ‘Better every day’ through continuous progress. Exhibit self\-drive as you ‘Take charge’ and lead with confidence. Additionally, demonstrate a collaborative spirit, knowing that we ‘Thrive together’ and support each other’s journeys.”
   

  

****JOB DESCRIPTION –****
 We are seeking a
 **proactive and detail\-oriented Renewable Energy Coordinator** 
 to oversee the
 **operational, financial, and performance management aspects of our renewable energy portfolio.** 
 The role will be responsible for supporting
 **asset operations, monitoring performance, managing SAP\-based** 
**procurement** 
 and
 **accounting processes** 
 , and ensuring compliance with corporate policies and regulatory requirements. The ideal candidate will possess
 **strong analytical skills, a hands\-on approach to problem\-solving,** 
 and a passion for
 **driving operational excellence in renewable energy projects.**
****Key Responsibilities****
**Operational Management**
* Coordinate the day\-to\-day operations of renewable energy assets, ensuring safe, reliable, and efficient performance.
* Monitor generation, equipment health, and asset availability through SCADA and performance monitoring systems.
* Identify operational issues, track corrective actions, and work closely with site teams and service providers to improve asset performance.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives focused on enhancing plant efficiency, reliability, and uptime.


**SAP, Procurement \& Financial Management**
* Manage SAP transactions related to Purchase Requisitions (PR), Purchase Orders (PO), Goods Receipt Notes (GRN), Service Entry Sheets (SES), and invoice processing.
* Coordinate procurement activities and ensure timely execution of purchasing and vendor payment processes.
* Verify invoices and support accurate cost allocation in accordance with approved budgets and accounting guidelines.
* Assist in budget monitoring, cost tracking, and preparation of asset\-wise financial reports and analyses.
* Prepare periodic reports covering operational expenses, cost variances, and asset performance.


**Performance Monitoring \& Reporting**
* Collect, analyze, and report operational, generation, and performance data across renewable energy assets.
* Track key performance indicators (KPIs) and compare actual performance against planned targets and contractual commitments.
* Develop and maintain dashboards and performance reports for effective monitoring and decision\-making.
* Identify performance gaps, generation losses, and improvement opportunities through data\-driven analysis.


**Project \& Vendor Coordination**
* Support the execution of asset optimization initiatives, performance improvement projects, and plant enhancement activities.
* Coordinate with site teams, OEMs, contractors, and vendors for maintenance, troubleshooting, and operational support.
* Assist in implementing digitalization and automation initiatives to improve monitoring, reporting, and operational efficiency.


**Compliance \& Documentation**
* Ensure compliance with company policies, regulatory requirements, contractual obligations, and industry standards.
* Maintain accurate records of operational data, SAP transactions, maintenance activities, and financial information.
* Prepare and maintain audit\-ready documentation and support internal and external audits.
* Provide timely reports and information to internal stakeholders and management as required.


**PPA \& Open Access Management**
* Support the administration and monitoring of Power Purchase Agreements (PPAs), Open Access arrangements, and related contractual obligations.
* Assist in coordinating with developers, DISCOMs, SLDCs, and other stakeholders for Open Access operations and compliance requirements.
* Track energy generation, consumption, scheduling, and monthly energy settlements to ensure accurate accounting and reporting.
* Review Open Access charges, banking adjustments, and energy\-related invoices, and support reconciliation activities.
* Prepare regular reports on PPA performance, Open Access operations, energy savings, and related regulatory compliance matters.


**Travel Estimate**
 Low
   

  

****Job Requirements****
**Educational Qualification**
 Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical / Instrumentation / Mechanical Engineering or equivalent
   

  

****Experience****
 3\+ years of experience in renewable energy asset management, understanding of renewable energy technologies, grid interconnection processes, and power purchase agreements (PPAs).
   

  

* Understanding of renewable energy systems, including performance monitoring and optimization.
* Expertise in SAP modules, especially for procurement and financial accounting processes.
* Proficiency in data analysis and visualization tools (e.g., Excel, Power BI).
* Excellent problem\-solving, organizational, and communication skills.
* Familiarity with accounting principles and budgeting for renewable energy assets is preferred.


**Your Success Matters to Us**
 At Sun Pharma, your success and well\-being are our top priorities! We provide robust benefits and opportunities to foster personal and professional growth. Join us at Sun Pharma, where every day is an opportunity to grow, collaborate, and make a lasting impact. Let’s create a brighter future together!

title: Senior Manager - Finance Operations (Reference Data Management)
description:
**About M\&G India**
 We are M\&G India, the strategic innovation and digital hub for M\&G. Established in 2003, we have offices in Mumbai and Pune.
   

  

 Our teams work closely with colleagues across the Group worldwide to drive transformation, build digital capability, and support sustainable growth. By leveraging technology, AI, automation, and process excellence, we bring new ways of thinking to improve outcomes for both customers and colleagues.
   

  

 Grounded in a vibrant culture with strong foundations, we are central to how M\&G is transforming as a business.
   

  

**About M\&G**
 Our purpose is to give everyone real confidence to put their money to work. With a heritage dating back more than 175 years, we have a long history of innovation in savings and investments, combining asset management and insurance expertise to offer a wide range of solutions.
   

  

 Our two distinct operating segments, Asset Management and Life, work together to provide access to balanced, long\-term investment and savings solutions.
   

  

 Through telling it like it is, owning it now, and moving it forward together with care and integrity; we are creating an exceptional place to work for exceptional talent.
   

  

* Reference Data Governance \& Maintenance


 Oversee the maintenance and governance of finance reference data, hierarchies and mapping structures across reporting platforms. Ensure approved changes are accurately implemented, validated and documented. This includes implementing changes resulting from business initiatives such as new funds, instruments, reporting requirements, or modifications to source system attributes. The role is responsible for ensuring the accuracy of the mapping tables based on business notifications of changes and the associated business requirements provided.
   

  

* Data Ingestion Oversight \& Exception Management


 Oversee the ingestion of data into the Fin Lakehouse (FLH) from upstream sources, including the Investment Data Platform (IDP), Aladdin Explore model stress factors, and FADS. This includes monitoring data loads for monthly reporting cycles (Mini dry\-run Provision, Long Form, Short Form) as well as daily reporting during stress scenarios. The role is responsible for monitoring the FLH Activity Dashboard and comparing ingestions against the expected list of data loads, escalating ingestion failures or issues, and tracking incidents through to resolution to ensure timely and accurate reporting.
   

  

* Reporting Cycle Readiness and Issue Management


 Track readiness of PS15/25 Liquidity Reporting inputs across monthly and stress reporting cycles. Monitor open issues, coordinate timely escalation, follow up on incident resolution, and ensure unresolved items are visible to relevant stakeholders ahead of reporting deadlines.
   

  

* Change Impact Assessment and Stakeholder Coordination


 Collaborate with Finance, Liquidity Reporting, Investment Data, FADS, Technology, and other relevant stakeholders to understand mapping or data change requirements, assess downstream reporting impacts, and support controlled implementation of changes.
   

  

* Controls, Documentation and Evidence Management


 Maintain appropriate documentation, trackers, control evidence, and working instructions to support mapping changes, ingestion monitoring, issue resolution, and auditability of the PS15/25 Liquidity Reporting support process.
   

  

 We have a diverse workforce and an inclusive culture at M\&G Global Services, regardless of gender, ethnicity, age, sexual orientation, nationality, disability or long term condition, we are looking to attract, promote and retain exceptional people. We also welcome those who take part in military service and those returning from career breaks.

title: Business Manager (Growth Track) – Atleisure by Roology
description:
**Location:** 
 Mumbai (Andheri West)
 **Employment type:** 
 Full\-time
 **Reports to:** 
 Founder
 **Team:** 
 1 intern will report to this role
 **Start date:** 
 October 1, 2026
 **Compensation:** 
 ₹25,000/month for the first 3 months, reviewed alongside the promotion decision below
 


 About Atleisure
 
 Atleisure by Roology is the newest label from Roology, a Mumbai\-based D2C womenswear brand. Atleisure is built around ease, not hustle — elevated comfort wear for women who are done performing productivity 24/7\. We're early\-stage, fast\-moving, and building the brand and the business at the same time — which means this role won't look like a "job description" for very long. It'll evolve as fast as you do.
 


 About the role
 
 We're hiring a generalist who wants to grow into a true Business Manager role — someone who can sit across operations, marketing, and finance in these early months, acting as the connective tissue between the founder, our vendors, our PR/social team, and everyone else keeping Atleisure running day to day. You'll also have an intern working under you from day one — so alongside learning the business, you'll be getting your first experience directing someone else's work.
 



 This is deliberately a
 **growth\-track role** 
 : you'll start hands\-on across all three functions, learning the business from the inside out. Based on performance, you'll be formally reviewed for promotion to
 **Business Manager within 3 months** 
 — with a compensation review at the same time — taking on greater ownership and ambiguity as you prove you can run with it.
 



 If you're early in your career and the idea of learning ops, marketing, and finance simultaneously at a founder's side — rather than being boxed into one narrow function — genuinely excites you, this is built for you.
 


 What you'll do
 
**Operations** 



* Coordinate day\-to\-day operations — vendor follow\-ups, order fulfillment tracking, inventory coordination
* Handle customer queries and support — order status, pre\- and post\-sales questions, and escalations
* Direct and check in on the intern's work, making sure their output actually moves things forward
* Act as the point of contact between the founder and external teams (PR, vendors, freelancers), making sure nothing falls through the cracks
* Document processes as you learn them, so the business runs on systems, not on memory



**Marketing** 



* Own the weekly content/posting calendar in coordination with our social/PR team, keeping Instagram active and on\-schedule
* Track campaign and content performance, flag what's working and what isn't
* Support influencer and PR outreach coordination



**Finance** 



* Track expenses, vendor payments, and basic budget\-vs\-actuals
* Support the founder in monthly financial reviews and reporting
* Flag discrepancies or gaps early, rather than after they've become a problem



**Mediator, across all of it** 



* Translate the founder's priorities into action across teams, and surface what each team needs back up to the founder
* Keep multiple moving parts (marketing, ops, finance, external vendors) talking to each other instead of operating in silos


 What we're looking for
 
**Skills** 



* Strong written and verbal communication — you'll be the go\-between for multiple people and functions, and customer\-facing at times
* Comfortable with spreadsheets (Excel/Google Sheets) for tracking and reporting
* Organized, detail\-oriented, able to juggle several open threads without dropping any
* Basic familiarity with Instagram/social platforms and e\-commerce (Shopify) is a plus, not a requirement



**Attitude** 



* Genuinely seeks to learn — asks questions, follows up, doesn't wait to be told twice
* Comfortable with ambiguity and a startup pace where the job description shifts as the business does
* Takes ownership rather than waiting for instructions on everything, and comfortable owning an intern's output as well as your own
* Resilient — early\-stage brands have setbacks and false starts, and we need someone who treats that as normal, not alarming



**Knowledge / background** 



* No prior experience in a specific function (ops, marketing, or finance) is required — full training will be provided
* Any prior exposure to D2C/e\-commerce, retail, or a startup environment is a bonus, not a must
* Freshers and early\-career candidates (0–2 years) are welcome to apply


 Why join
 * Direct mentorship from the founder, with real exposure to how a D2C brand is actually built and run
* Early people\-management experience — you'll have an intern supporting you from day one
* A defined growth path — a formal shot at the Business Manager title (and a compensation review) within your first 3 months, not a vague "maybe someday"
* The chance to shape a young brand's systems from the ground up, rather than inheriting someone else's playbook
* Part of the Roology family — access to the learning, processes, and network of an already\-running sister brand


 How to apply
 
 Email us at arushi@atleisureculture.com

title: Financial Markets Infrastructure Risk Management, VP (Hybrid)
description:
Financial Markets Infrastructure Risk Management (FMIRM) Officer is a risk manager role within the FMIRM function in Citigroup. The FMIRM Officer is responsible for the credit risk management of Citi’s exposure including membership and /or bilateral activity with Financial Market Infrastructure (FMI) entities including Central Clearing Counterparties for Derivatives and Securities and FMIs intermediaries for Payments and Custody services.
   

  

 The role will be focused on FMIs in the Asia Pacific region. The candidate will also interface from a risk management perspective with external bodies including the FMIs, industry bodies and regulators.
   

  

**Responsibilities** 
 :
   

  

* Conduct new FMI memberships reviews and material changes at existing FMIs
* Responsible for review and challenge first line risk on proposed risk ratings, limits and corresponding annual reviews
* Contribute to the New Approval Committee process for new FMI memberships
* Ensure timely communication and escalation of credit changes and concerns, changes at CCPs or other industry developments across Asia Clusters
* Maintain ongoing contact with senior business/product managers across Markets, Treasury and Trade Solutions, Institutional Credit Management (ICM), Legal and Operations
* Represent FMIRM on internal and external risk forums/committees as required
* Ensure timely analysis and remediation of FMI exposures including reviewing with the relevant desks
* Assess the impact of emerging and existing risks in FMI portfolio
* Ensure awareness of latest markets news, regulatory changes, impact on related FMIs and take actions as required
* Collaborating with Business, ICM and Technology teams on automation and data quality issues


**Knowledge/Experience:**
* Candidates should have a minimum of 8 years of experience in a large Financial Institution or FMI.
* Prior experience in FMI Risk Management or Financial Institutions Credit risk
* Strong understanding of FMI risk including exposure measurements, rulebooks and regulatory landscape as well as margin methodologies
* In\-depth knowledge of financial markets and products such as Exchange\-traded and OTC derivatives, Securities \& Cash Clearing and Payments systems
* Experience interacting with senior management, regulators, and internal audit as well as managing regulatory examinations and audit reviews
* Experience in driving own book of work and delivering against multiple initiatives
* Proven experience of influencing stakeholders


**Skills/Competencies:**
* Excellent organizational and communication skills (written and verbal)
* Superior analytical and quantitative skills and be able to quickly distil large amount of information to key risks
* Ability to work collaboratively with a wide group of cross\-functional stakeholders across all levels
* Demonstrated ability to lead meetings/calls, to listen to other points of view, provide appropriate challenge, influence partners
* Regularly communicates and ensures key messages are cascaded throughout the broader teams
* Demonstrates integrity and sound independent risk judgment and operates to the highest ethical standard
* Self\-starter who takes initiatives, highly motivated and aspirational


**Education:**
* Educated to quantitative/finance master's degree standard or equivalent

title: Index Client Service Associate
description:
Your Team Responsibilities
   

  

 MSCI Global Index Client Service is the primary point of contact for clients and users of MSCI Index products and serves as the key link to MSCI's Global Research and Index operations. The team members are responsible for directly responding to a wide variety of methodology, usage, interpretational and technical questions on MSCI benchmark products.
   

  

 The MSCI Index Client Service team is composed of experienced financial professionals that provide first tier support for our institutional, dominantly financial institutional clients around the world. Globally the Index Client Service group is present in the following locations: San Francisco, Monterrey, New York, London, Budapest, Mumbai, Shanghai and Manila
   

  

 Your Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Gain a deep understanding of MSCI index construction methodologies This includes remaining up to date with ongoing enhancements as well as new products as necessary.
* Able to master MSCI Index tools, applications and an usage of MSCI data
* Directly assist global clients via phone and email by answering detailed questions on our products and methodology, including
* Index construction, rebalancing and corporate event methodologies for our standard and customized indexes
* Providing trainings on the usage of our products, tools and applications
* Assisting clients with the ongoing usage of our products, data requests
* Working with internal departments to ensure all clients requests/inquiries are managed appropriately
* Conduct service reviews with clients on a regular basis
* Act as a liaison and source of feedback directly to Sales, Research, Product Management, Finance and Product Delivery groups.
* Ensuring current clients are aware of important changes and developments to the MSCI indexes
* Taking ownership of various initiatives that are aiming to improve the client experience and the efficiency of our processes
* Perform any other tasks as assigned by line manager


**Your Skills And Experience That Will Help You Excel**
* Strong Numerate bachelor’s degree in Economics or Finance
* 3\-5 years experience in client relationship management

title: Head of Corporate Finance
description:
**About the Company** 




  





**Head \- Corporate Finance and Investor Relations \|**
 Vantrock Real Assets \| MumbaiThis seat builds the capital structure of the platform, structures the transactions that grow it \- acquisitions, joint ventures, joint developments and platform deals \- and owns the institutions that fund it. We are looking for someone from the principal's side of the table, not from an advisory bench.
 



  





 ABOUT VANTROCKVantrock is an independent real assets platform. Real assets only. We start where we know the ground: logistics, warehousing and industrial parks, across the full chain \- first mile, last mile, city\-centre, dark\-store and self\-storage formats, and logistics\-anchored mixed\-use. From there, in sequence and only as each is delivered: industrial plots; suburban campuses, GCC and back\-office space; strata offices; and, in parallel, data centres and senior living.The platform is founded by Anshul Singhal, Founder \& CEO, who has built every platform he led as if it were his own \- three times over, on other people's capital. This is the fourth build, on his own. Across his career that record runs to 52 million sq ft delivered, 32 million as developer and 20 million as contractor, over 2,000 acres acquired and all of them litigation\-free, and more than 200 buildings. Delivered across the founder's three prior platforms. The board is chaired by Shailesh V. Haribhakti, and the platform runs on Vantrock Intelligence, its own AI\-native operating layer.The current pipeline is 10 million sq ft. Ground breaks on the first 2 million sq ft in January 2027\.
 



  





**About the Role** 




  





 This seat builds the capital structure of the platform, structures the transactions that grow it \- acquisitions, joint ventures, joint developments and platform deals \- and owns the institutions that fund it. We are looking for someone from the principal's side of the table, not from an advisory bench.
 



  





  





**Responsibilities \=** 
 WHAT YOU WILL OWN
 



  





  




* The function. A General Manager for Debt Raising and Treasury and a Manager for Corporate Finance. You set the strategy they execute and you are accountable for the whole capital position, not either half.
* The capital structure. How each asset is funded across the founder's equity, co\-investment, asset\-level debt and platform facilities, and how that changes from land to delivery to stabilisation.
* Mergers, acquisitions and platform transactions. Entities, portfolios, part\-built assets, and the share\-versus\-asset question that decides the tax and the risk. Valuation, the offer, diligence across legal, technical, financial and tax, the share purchase and shareholders' agreements, escrows, indemnities, earn\-outs, and the integration after signing.
* Joint venture and joint development structuring, and the vehicles under everything. Special purpose vehicle design, forward sale and built\-to\-suit structures, and the tax and regulatory shape beneath them. Vantrock works with landowners four ways \- outright purchase, joint venture, joint development on the owner's land, and a long lease where the owner keeps title. You build the structure under each: contribution, waterfall, exit, the protections on both sides, and the model that says which of the four a parcel should take.
* The institutional relationships on the capital side. Lenders, co\-investors, forward buyers, and strategic partners, at asset and platform level, built from zero and owned for the life of the platform.
* The underwriting model and the capital case. The model that goes in front of an institution, built by you, defended by you, tied back to what the operating team can actually deliver.
* Investor reporting and the institutional voice. Quarterly reporting, the data room, diligence responses, and a live dashboard our partners see rather than a pack assembled under pressure.
* Rating agency and lender\-facing narrative. CRISIL, ICRA and CARE, the information memorandum, and the credit story the platform tells every counterparty consistently.
* Readiness for what comes next. The reporting discipline, governance and structures needed before an InvIT or a REIT is a real conversation rather than a slide.



  





  





**Qualifications** 




  




* CA, MBA in Finance . An engineering first degree alongside any of those is an advantage in this sector, not a requirement.



  





**Required Skills \-** 
 WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR
 



  





  




* 14\+ years, the recent part of it in corporate finance, mergers and acquisitions, capital markets or institutional investment inside real estate, infrastructure or a comparable capital\-intensive sector.
* Principal\-side experience is essential. Time at a developer, platform, institutional investor or lender where you carried the outcome. Pure advisory or pure research careers do not clear this seat alone; advisory followed by a principal chapter does.
* Mergers and acquisitions carried as a principal, not advised on from outside. At least two closed transactions where you ran or co\-ran the commercial structuring \- valuation, diligence, the share purchase or business transfer agreement, and what you negotiated into the warranties and indemnities.
* Joint ventures and joint development agreements structured with landowners or partners, with the waterfall, the exit and the protections you personally argued for. That is what separates a deal that survives year seven from one that does not.
* Fluency on the debt side as well as the equity side, including the public sector and development finance channel \- NaBFID under its Transport and Logistics mandate, IIFCL, HUDCO, SIDBI, NABARD and the project finance desks of the public sector banks \- because on a platform this size the two conversations are one conversation.
* Modelling you do yourself. Advanced Excel, a model built from a blank sheet, and the confidence to be cross\-examined on any cell.
* SAP, Oracle or equivalent, and weekly use of AI tools with the judgement to know when they are wrong.



  





**Preferred Skills** 




  




* An engineering first degree alongside CA or MBA in Finance is an advantage in this sector, not a requirement.



  





 WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT
 


* It is not fund raising from limited partners. Fund\-side relationships sit with the investment manager.
* It is not accounting

title: Assistant Vice President Finance
description:
**Assistant Vice President Finance \&
 
 Debt Raising**




  





 You report to the Head of Corporate Finance and Investor Relations Or CFO who sets the capital strategy you raise against. This is the seat that goes to the lenders.
 



  





 WHAT YOU WILL OWN
 



  





 \- The debt strategy and the lender map. Which lender for which asset, at which stage, at what tenor and what cost. Construction finance, term loans, lease rental discounting, structured and mezzanine debt, non\-convertible debentures, and the refinancing that follows.
 



 \- The public sector and development finance channel. NaBFID under its Transport and Logistics mandate, IIFCL, HUDCO, SIDBI and NABARD where the asset qualifies, and the project finance and infrastructure desks of the public sector banks. This channel is long\-tenor, lower\-cost and under\-used by developers of our size, and building it is a stated objective of the seat rather than an afterthought.
 



 \- The private channel alongside it. Private and foreign banks, housing finance companies, infrastructure finance companies and NBFCs, insurance and pension money for long\-tenor paper, private credit and alternative investment funds, and offshore and development finance institution lines where they price better than domestic.
 



 \- Every term sheet, from first approach to disbursement. Structuring, negotiation, security creation, covenants, conditions precedent and subsequent, inter\-creditor arrangements, and the discipline of never signing a covenant the asset cannot live with.
 



 \- Treasury. Cash flow forecasting across special purpose vehicles, drawdown scheduling against construction progress, surplus deployment, banking relationships and mandates, interest rate and currency exposure, and the controls that keep all of it clean.
 



 \- The credit story. Rating agency engagement with CRISIL, ICRA and CARE, the information memorandum, the lender pack, and the quarterly reporting that keeps a lender comfortable between drawdowns.
 



 \- Lender diligence and covenant compliance, run as a discipline rather than a scramble. Technical, legal and financial diligence coordinated by you, with the answers ready before the question.
 



  





 WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR
 



  





 \- 12 \+ years, with the recent part of it raising debt for real estate, warehousing, industrial or infrastructure assets.
 



 \- Borrower\-side experience is essential. A lender\-side career alone does not qualify, and a career that has only ever been lender\-side will not clear this seat. If you have been both \- credit or project finance at a bank or an NBFC, then corporate finance at a developer or a platform \- that is the profile we want most.
 



 \- Closed transactions you can name and size. Construction finance, lease rental discounting, structured debt or NCDs, with the tenor, the pricing and what you negotiated out of the term sheet.
 



 \- Direct experience with at least one public sector or development finance institution \- NaBFID, IIFCL, HUDCO, SIDBI, NABARD, or a public sector bank's project finance or infrastructure group. This is the channel we intend to build and we would rather hire someone who has already walked into those rooms.
 



 \- Treasury run in practice, not in theory: cash flow forecasting across multiple entities, drawdown discipline against construction milestones, and banking mandates you owned.
 



 \- CA, MBA in Finance, or CFA. An engineering first degree alongside any of those is an advantage in this sector, not a requirement.
 



 \- Advanced Microsoft Excel, and financial models you built yourself rather than inherited. Experience with SAP, Oracle or an equivalent treasury or ERP platform.
 



 \- Weekly use of AI tools, and the judgement to know when they are wrong.
 



  





 WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT
 



  





 \- It is not fund raising from limited partners. Institutional capital and investor relations sit with the Head of Corporate Finance and Investor Relations, this seat's reporting line, and fund\-side relationships sit with the investment manager.
 



 \- It is not accounting or controllership. The books, the close and project accounting sit in finance and accounts.
 



 \- It is not a relationship\-management seat at a bank in a developer's clothing. You are on the borrower's side and you are expected to argue.

 The FP\&A Manager is a senior member of the FP\&A team, responsible for owning significant areas of planning, forecasting, performance management and decision support.
   

  

 This is a broad, hands\-on role for someone who can take complex or loosely defined financial problems, turn them into structured workstreams and deliver high\-quality solutions with limited oversight.
   

  

 A key measure of success will be taking end\-to\-end ownership of important FP\&A projects, models and processes, materially reducing the need for the Director of FP\&A to remain involved in their design, build and day\-to\-day operation. The role has no direct reports, but is expected to provide technical leadership, coaching and mentoring across the FP\&A team.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 Planning and forecasting
   

  

* Jointly lead significant elements of the annual budget and planning process alongside the Director of FP\&A.
* Own and improve forecasting methodology, models and processes across FP\&A.
* Challenge assumptions and hold FP\&A and business stakeholders accountable for forecast quality and agreed actions.


 Financial modelling and analysis
   

  

* Build and own complex financial models across revenue, costs, headcount and other business drivers.
* Translate complex business questions into clear financial analysis and decision support.
* Ensure models are robust, scalable, well controlled and capable of being operated by others.


 Business partnering and decision support
   

  

* Act as a proactive Finance partner to LT\-1 leaders and their teams.
* Ensure spend managers are aware of their budget responsibilities and approval processes.
* Consistently and relentlessly enforce spending discipline across the business.


 FP\&A transformation
   

  

* Take end\-to\-end ownership of significant FP\&A projects.
* Lead the use of automation, AI and improved data processes.
* Build solutions that become embedded in normal business activity and free the FP\&A team capacity for high\-value work.


 Performance management
   

  

* Own and improve key elements of FP\&A management information.
* Focus reporting and analysis on underlying drivers of performance, risks and opportunities.
* Ensure senior stakeholders understand what has happened, why it has happened and what action is required.


 Team leadership and development
   

  

* Guide and mentor junior colleagues through complex financial and analytical work.
* Delegate elements of projects, review outputs and help raise standards across the team.
* Share knowledge and build repeatable approaches that increase overall FP\&A capability.


**Person Specification**
**Essential**
* Operate independently, seeking guidance only on the most significant issues.

* Build scalable solutions.
* Grip ambiguous problems by developing clear plans and recommendations.
* Lead complex projects involving multiple contributors and stakeholders.

 Desirable

 The Market Risk Stress Testing Reporting Lead is part of Citi’s Risk Management community. Within Risk Management the role sits within the Data, Analytics, Reporting and Technology (DART) function. DART is responsible for (i) supporting intelligent risk decisions and proactive management of Citi’s risks across the enterprise, (ii) delivering risk information and analysis to help risk managers, the business, and senior management navigate complex risks and regulatory landscape, (iii) providing deep expertise in risk data and dimensions in the development and production of reports and analytics, (iv) designing policies, defining leading practices and innovative technological tooling in performance of risk data governance and strategy roles.
   

  

 The role will lead the team responsible for Market Risk Stress Testing Reporting including both Internal and Regulatory required processes. The team works with Risk Managers, Business, Finance, Technology, and the Capital Planning teams to establish reporting requirements, develop the tools and analysis necessary to proactively identify and manage risk with respect to portfolios and products while continuously updating the process to reflect the current business structure.
   

  

 The candidate will also play a prominent role in the transformation of the Global Market Risk Reporting Process and will be supporting critical organizational programs helping drive innovation and the migration to modern reporting platforms and business intelligence.

title: Financial Reporting Analyst
description:
A Fortune 200 enterprise is scaling its Global Capability Centre in India, and its record\-to\-report pod has partnered with Flexiple to hire a Financial Reporting Analyst who will own a slice of the monthly and quarterly close for one of its regional business units.
 



**Where this sits in the centre** 




 The centre's finance function has moved past pure transaction processing and is now expected to produce reporting packs that regional CFOs actually read. This analyst joins a pod of six, reporting into a Reporting Manager, and will be one of the first hires trusted to question a variance rather than simply restate it.
 



**What lands on your desk each month** 



* Prepare and review journal entries, accruals and balance sheet reconciliations for two to three assigned entities ahead of monthly close
* Draft management reporting packs, flagging variances against budget and prior period with a first\-pass explanation before the review call
* Support statutory and group reporting deliverables, including audit schedules and the walkthroughs external auditors ask for
* Maintain reconciliation trackers and chase open items with regional finance teams before they age past 30 days
* Feed into the centre's ongoing effort to standardise reporting templates across entities acquired at different times



**What we need from day one** 




 1 to 5 years in financial reporting, general ledger accounting or audit, ideally with some exposure to a multi\-entity or shared\-services environment. Excel fluency at a formula\-and\-pivot level is assumed; prior exposure to an ERP such as SAP or Oracle, and to a consolidation tool such as HFM or OneStream, is a genuine advantage. You should be someone who reads a trial balance for what it is telling you, not just for what it says on the page.
 



**Where you would be based** 




 Bengaluru, Mumbai, Delhi NCR, Hyderabad, Pune, Chennai or Remote (India).
 



**How the process runs** 




 An initial HR conversation is followed by a short reporting assignment, a working round with the Reporting Manager, and a closing conversation on fit with the wider finance team.
 



 One application from you is kept on file and considered against this opening and any other reporting roles that open up across our client base.
 



 Interested candidates can apply directly through this listing.

title: Client Relationship Support
description:
**Some Careers Open More Doors Than Others.**
 If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
   

  

**Business Description**
 HSBC Corporate and Institutional Banking is a markets\-led, financing\-focused business that provides investment and financial solutions. Through our international network, we connect emerging and mature markets, covering key growth areas. We partner with our corporate, government and institutional clients to help them achieve consistent, long\-term performance. Our products and services include advisory, financing, prime services, research and analysis, securities services, trading and sales and transaction banking.
   

  

**Role Purpose**
 Credit \& Capital Management (C\&CM) under CIB are in the process of implementing a new, modern, and consistent E2E operating model. A key component of this operating model is the introduction of a first line credit management office, the Business Credit Office (BCO)
   

  

 The BCO function will complete tasks currently owned by multiple actors including Credit Analysis Unit, Credit Analysts, and RMs in the management of the first line credit risk responsibilities including structuring, credit analysis and rating recommendation, client credit monitoring tasks, credit terms and docs negotiation with WCMR and clients acting as a single handoff from a RM to the BCO for all C\&L tasks, creating a single control point. The function will be client facing and customer service orientated.
   

  

 The BCO Manager provides credit management support to Relationship Managers (RMs) / Coverage and facilitates client review and renewal activities, and is responsible for carrying out customer outreach, research, financial and credit analysis on behalf of the RMs, ensuring exemplary risk management acumen and control standards are embedded within the end\-to\-end C\&L process. In discharging their duties the role holder must ensure a common, reliable, and predictable underwriting and lending process, that protects the business from exposure, whilst responding to clients borrowing needs. They are also responsible for co\-ordination and completion of credit applications or renewals and risk escalation management. The role holder will report to the BCO Team Lead and will work closely with the Coverage and Transaction Support teams to ensure seamless customer experience and consistency of service for all customers.
   

  

 The BCO manager will need to be an effective collaborator and skilled stakeholder manager, successfully navigating complex landscape to deliver exceptional outcomes for our customers and stakeholders.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Responsible for the delivery of BCO tasks in line with agreed OKRs, SLAs and KPIs
* Own the end\-to\-end Credit \& Lending servicing journey, ensuring a seamless and efficient process for customers and internal stakeholders
* Combine client relationship management with strong risk assessment and management capabilities ensuring the required credit quality \& requisite returns on risk
* Continuously drive improvement in their productivity whilst enhancing client experience.
* Adopt technology and customer experience improvement initiatives, including alignment to a globally consistent C\&L operating model and active participation in training initiatives
* Participate in deal discussions and meetings with clients or credit risk as required
* Strong execution and implementation ability.
* Ability to build and maintain strong relationships across the teams, including credibility with both Business and Risk leaders.
* Protect the Bank by acting as First Line of Defence and adhering to all controls
* Maintain HSBC internal control standards, including timely implementation of internal and external audit recomentations, along with addressing any issues raised by external regulators
* Demonstrates ability to engage in constructive and consistent dialogue with risk partners, in a manner that effectively balances commercial outcomes and risk management
* Work with the BCO Team Lead to ensure adequate credit risk management controls are built into the operational process and robust MI is in place to track and measure risk against agreed thresholds


**Knowledge And Experience**
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, or a related field
* 5\-8 years corporate lending experience with strong analytical skills and sound credit knowledge
* Strong understanding of various financing instruments and banking products for Wholesale Banking
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to navigate complex situations and drive alignment among senior leaders
* Clear understanding of the Group credit risk principles, policies and statutory compliances
* Strong commercial mindset
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate effectively across all levels of the organization


**Additional Notes**
* Familiarity with AI\-enabled tools is an advantage.
* Mandatory to successfully complete Anti\-Money Laundering and Sanctions training and post\-course assessment, as required


 As an employee, you are required to perform your duties in a professional capacity exercising independent judgement, discretion and decision\-making authority in planning, organising, directing work, supervising and appraising the work of team members, as applicable; and taking accountability for delivery outcomes. You will represent the organization with relevant internal and external stakeholders. You will allocate and prioritize work, provide direction and feedback, manage team capacity and leave in line with policy as applicable.
   

  

 HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment.
   

  

 Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

title: Financial Reporting Assistant Manager
description:
**About the company:** 




 BDO is a global network of professional services firms with a presence in over 166 countries, revenue of over USD 14 billion, and experience of over 60 years. Its a leading service provider for the mid\-markets with client service at its heart.
 



  





 BDO India Services Private Limited (or BDO India) is the India member firm of BDO International. BDO India offers strategic, operational, accounting and tax, and regulatory advisory \& assistance for both domestic and international organizations across a range of industries. BDO India is led by more than 300\+ Partners \& Directors with a team of over 10,000 professionals operating across 14 cities and 20 offices. We expect to grow sizably in the coming 3\-5 years, adding various dimensions to our business and multiplying and increasing the current team size multi\-fold.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 We are looking for an experienced Financial Reporting Manager to take ownership of the financial reporting and month\-end close process across group entities. This is a hands\-on individual contributor role requiring strong technical accounting expertise, audit management capabilities, and a strong focus on internal controls and financial governance.
 



  





 The role will work closely with Service Lines, FP\&A, Tax, Treasury, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Compliance, and senior leadership to ensure accurate, timely, and compliant financial reporting.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



  





**Financial Reporting \& Month\-End Close** 



* Own and drive the monthly financial reporting and close process across group entities.
* Ensure timely and accurate closure of monthly books within defined timelines.
* Review trial balances, general ledger accounts, and supporting schedules.
* Review and ensure accurate accounting of provisions, accruals, prepayments, depreciation, amortization, and other month\-end entries.
* Perform detailed variance analysis of actuals versus budget, forecast, and prior periods, and highlight key business drivers to management.
* Ensure completeness and accuracy of financial data across entities.



  





**Financial Statements \& Accounting Compliance** 



* Prepare and review annual financial statements in accordance with applicable accounting standards, including Ind AS / Local GAAP.
* Ensure appropriate accounting treatment for complex transactions and financial reporting matters.
* Provide accurate financial information, schedules, and supporting documentation for regulatory and statutory filings.
* Partner with the Compliance and Secretarial teams to ensure timely and accurate regulatory reporting.



  





**Statutory \& Internal Audit Management** 



* Lead and manage statutory audits across group entities.
* Coordinate and support internal audits, including preparation of audit schedules, reconciliations, supporting documents, and deliverables.
* Act as the key point of contact between auditors and internal stakeholders.
* Manage audit timelines and ensure timely closure of audit observations and queries.
* Proactively identify and resolve audit issues with minimal escalation.



  





**Internal Financial Controls \& Governance** 



* Execute and monitor Internal Financial Controls over Financial Reporting (IFCR/IFC) within the reporting function.
* Ensure appropriate documentation and testing of key financial controls.
* Identify control gaps and drive timely remediation.
* Strengthen financial governance and control frameworks across entities.
* Ensure compliance with internal policies, accounting standards, and reporting requirements.



  





**Lease Accounting \& Fixed Assets** 



* Manage lease accounting, including maintenance of lease trackers and periodic accounting entries.
* Ensure appropriate accounting and reporting under Ind AS 116, where applicable.
* Oversee fixed asset accounting, including capitalization, depreciation, disposals, and reconciliation.
* Ensure accuracy and completeness of fixed asset registers and related schedules.



  





**Balance Sheet \& Month\-End Governance** 



* Ensure all balance sheet schedules are prepared, reviewed, and reconciled on a monthly basis.
* Maintain strong controls over provisions and expense recognition.
* Ensure appropriate cut\-off procedures and completeness of expense recognition.
* Investigate and resolve long\-outstanding reconciling items and unusual balances.
* Drive high standards of accuracy and financial discipline across the reporting process.



  





**Stakeholder Management** 



* Collaborate closely with Service Lines, FP\&A, AP, AR, Tax, Treasury, Compliance, and other cross\-functional teams.
* Provide management with relevant financial information, analysis, and insights.
* Partner with stakeholders to resolve accounting, reporting, and close\-related issues.
* Build strong working relationships with senior stakeholders and external auditors.



  





**Process Improvement \& Systems** 



* Identify opportunities to improve and standardize financial reporting and close processes.
* Drive standardization of reconciliations, reporting schedules, and management reporting formats.
* Identify opportunities to strengthen controls and improve process efficiency.
* Support enhanced utilization and optimization of ERP systems such as Microsoft Dynamics 365, SAP, or Oracle.
* Drive process improvements, automation, and reporting efficiencies wherever relevant.



  





**Qualifications \& Experience** 



* Chartered Accountant (CA) Mandatory.
* 2\-5 years of post\-qualification experience in financial reporting, accounting, controllership, or related finance functions.
* Strong hands\-on experience in:
* Financial reporting and financial statements
* Month\-end and year\-end close
* Statutory and internal audits
* Balance sheet reconciliations
* Internal financial controls
* Technical accounting
* Experience managing reporting across multiple entities will be preferred.
* Experience in professional services, consulting, Big 4, or similar environments will be an advantage.
* Working knowledge of ERP systems such as Microsoft Dynamics 365, SAP, or Oracle.

 We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join WPB Risk team as Vice President – Retail Collateral Risk Management.
   

  

**Job Introduction**
* Vice President\- Retail Collateral Risk Management is responsible for the management of collateral risk in order to achieve the credit risk appetite and enable business growth.
* The most significant need that the incumbent has to fulfill is to manage developer and under\-construction project approvals and monitoring (especially technical / valuation related nuances), design policies and review controls around valuation of current and impaired mortgage assets, monitor Real Estate market trends (primary and secondary), regulatory landscape. title: Analyst — FP&A
description:
Analyst — FP\&A \| Vantrock Real Assets Private Limited \| Mumbai Metropolitan Region
 



  
 



 Build and hold the models a real assets platform forecasts on — development appraisals, project cash flows, rent rolls, debt schedules — and learn from the Financial Controller how a number becomes a decision. Modelling as a craft, not a skill.
 



  
 



 A note before you read on. The team structure, reporting lines, direct reports, seat titles and hiring entity described in this brief reflect the platform's current plan and may change as the platform builds out. Compensation and incentive structures are confirmed in the offer, not here.
 



  
 



 REPORTS TO: Financial Controller — Head of FP\&A \& Asset Management · EXPERIENCE: 2–5 years in financial modelling, FP\&A or transaction analysis, in or around real estate
 



  
 



 ABOUT VANTROCK
 



 Vantrock is India's independent, operator\-led real assets platform — real assets only — with logistics and industrial as the first phase of its growth.
 



 Founded by Anshul Singhal, Founder \& CEO, who has built three institutional platforms from zero and is building the fourth on his own capital: 52 million sq ft delivered (32 million as developer, 20 million as contractor), 2,000\+ acres acquired, 200\+ buildings, two SEBI Category II funds run to a successful close, India's first domestic warehousing AIF and India's largest industrial real estate exit — delivered across the founder's three prior platforms.
 



  
 



 THE FINANCE \& ACCOUNTS TEAM
 



 Vantrock keeps its books in\-house. The finance function owns every number from the site to the board.
 



 Twenty\-one seats when fully built; sixteen live now, one of them already filled. Small enough that every person in it is known by name to the founder; large enough to run a platform properly. Every seat in the team is a builder's seat: the function does not exist yet in the form described here, and the people who join it now are the ones who will decide what it becomes.
 



  
 



 THE MODEL IS THE TOOL; THE FORECAST IS THE PRODUCT
 



 Vantrock separates the two things a finance function does with a number. The accounts team records what happened. The FP\&A and Asset Management team — the Financial Controller and this seat — says what will happen and raises a hand early when the two drift apart. Every asset against the underwriting it was bought on. Every construction budget against its bill of quantities. Every lease against the rent roll it was modelled at. Every procurement decision priced before it is made.
 



  
 



 WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS
 



 The Financial Controller's seat is forecasting, red\-flagging and the Asset Review — and it cannot be done alone. The models have to be built, refreshed, reconciled to the books and stress\-tested every month, for a pipeline of 10 million sq ft across four cities and a set of strategies queued behind the first. This seat does that work, and is the seat from which the platform intends to grow the next Financial Controller.
 



  
 



 WHAT YOU WILL OWN
 



 1\. The models. Development appraisals, project cash flows, lease\-up and rent\-roll models, debt schedules, exit models — built to the platform's standard, documented, version\-controlled, and reconciled to the ledger every month.
 



 2\. The rolling forecast, mechanics. The monthly refresh for the platform and every project entity — actuals pulled from the books, assumptions updated with the project, leasing and procurement teams, variances computed and listed for the Financial Controller's review.
 



 3\. The Asset Review pack, first draft. Every asset's page — actuals against underwriting, cost against budget, the triggers — assembled from the dashboards and the models for the Financial Controller to finish and present.
 



 4\. Variance analysis. Every material variance traced to its cause and written up in two lines before it reaches the Financial Controller — not discovered in the meeting.
 



 5\. The founder's question. The ad\-hoc analysis — what does this lease do to the exit, what does this contractor's variation do to cost\-to\-complete — turned around the same day, correctly.
 



 6\. The operating layer. Models and trackers live on the platform's dashboards, not in a private spreadsheet.
 



  
 



 WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR
 



 ESSENTIAL
 



 – 2–5 years in financial modelling, FP\&A or transaction analysis, at a real estate developer, an investor, a lender's real estate team, a consultancy serving real estate, or a fund.
 



 – Modelling as a craft. You have built a development appraisal or a project cash\-flow model from a blank sheet — not modified a template — and you can explain every assumption in it. This will be tested in a case.
 



 – Accounting literacy: you can read a trial balance, tie a model to a ledger and know why the two disagree.
 



 – Excel at an expert level, and fluency with at least one of the modern tools around it — Python, SQL, a BI layer, or the platform's own dashboards.
 



 – Precise, fast and honest about uncertainty. You say "I don't know" before you guess.
 



 – A Chartered Accountant, or an MBA in Finance. Either. An MBA from a second\-tier institution with three years of the right modelling outranks a first\-tier degree with none.
 



 – Based in the Mumbai Metropolitan Region, or relocating before joining.
 



 WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT
 



 – Not an investment\-banking analyst seat. The models here are held for years and reconciled monthly; they are not built for a pitch and forgotten.
 



 – Not a reporting seat. You build and analyse; the dashboards report.
 



 – Not a seat for someone who wants to be told what to model. The Financial Controller will set the question; finding the right model is your job.
 



  
 



 HOW YOU WILL WORK
 



 – The books are in\-house. You reconcile your models to a ledger kept twenty feet away, every month.
 



 – Everything runs on the platform's dashboards. No private spreadsheets; every model has a home, a version and an owner.
 



 – Judgment is written down. Every assumption has a source; every variance has a two\-line cause.
 



 – Mumbai Metropolitan Region, full\-time, in person, with occasional site visits.
 



  
 



 COMPENSATION
 



 Vantrock benchmarks compensation against the upper quartile for the role and market, weighted toward equity for candidates who want to build with us long\-term. We discuss specific numbers in the first conversation rather than anchoring either side prematurely.
 



 Wealth creation is part of the engine, not only the salary: a performance\-linked annual bonus, and a path to ESOP\-linked incentives as the seat grows — priced to the seat and confirmed in the offer.
 



  
 



 CULTURAL FIT
 



 We're building Vantrock over a decade, not a funding cycle. We're looking for people who treat technology as the default answer rather than a supplement, who want to be co\-builders of the platform rather than employees executing instructions, and who are comfortable saying "I don't know" and "I was wrong." If you want a defined role with defined edges, this isn't the right seat. If you want to help build an institution from zero, it might be.
 



 AI proficiency is a standing requirement in every Vantrock seat. You work fluently with AI tools for research, modelling, drafting and analysis, and you build on the platform's dashboards rather than around them. A supervised AI Proficiency Test is part of the process for every seat, at every level of seniority, and we say so openly.
 



 Partner command is the second standing requirement. The books are ours, but auditors, banks, the fund administrator, valuers, law firms and system vendors are commanded by this team — briefed, held to a standard, integrated — never deferred to. We hire for judgment and accountability.
 



  
 



 HOW WE WILL ASSESS
 



 Everyone who applies hears from us within two working days. It carries two links: a fixed set of six questions answered by AI interview — about forty minutes, and the first work sample; we review it before the CV — and the Vantrock AI Proficiency Test, which every hire takes at every level. From there:
 



 1\. The Model conversation. The best model you have built from a blank sheet: what it decided, what it got wrong, what you would change. With the Financial Controller.
 



 2\. A 90\-minute supervised case. A data pack for a warehousing development — land, approvals timeline, construction budget, a pre\-lease term sheet, a facility term sheet — from which you build the project cash flow, compute three headline outputs, and state the three assumptions you are least sure of. Reviewed with the Financial Controller and the CFO — or the Founder \& CEO until the CFO is in seat.
 



 3\. References. One or two former reporting managers, contacted directly.
 



 Once we have received your application, your AI interview and your test, we will reach out with next steps. Your application is confidential: it is seen only by the Founder's Office and the hiring lead, and nothing is shared with your current employer or referenced without your consent.
 



  
 



 TO APPLY
 



 Write to careers@vantrock.com with the subject line "Analyst — FP\&A — \[your name]", and attach:
 



 – Your CV. This is mandatory — a LinkedIn profile alone is not an application; we will read your LinkedIn as well.
 



 – One model you built from a blank sheet — anonymised as needed — with three sentences on what was hard about it. A screenshot is not a model; send the file or a link to it.
 



 – Your notice period and what you would need to see to move.
 



 – One short paragraph: the assumption in a development appraisal that most often turns out wrong, and how you would build the model so that being wrong about it is visible early. That paragraph matters more than the CV.
 



 We read everything that arrives with a model and a paragraph — properly, not skimmed. If this sounds like your seat, write to us.
 



  
 



 We don't hire roles. We build the platform. · Ownership, not employment. · Builders hire builders.
 




 Founder \& CEO, Vantrock

We are Licious and we are a Bengaluru based meat and seafood company founded in 2015 by Abhay Hanjura and Vivek Gupta, our founders, foodies and friends. Also making sure that there is no pile\-up of payables / GRIR due to erroneous entries recorded by the operations team.
